label: PF Backlog 559
title: Per-item token/cache/cost usage (execution.usage) + runtime usage capture + rollup
body:
## Why
No per-item token/cache/cost telemetry; only pipeline-level call_ledger. Needed per backlog item for cost analysis.

## What
- backlog execution: + usage{} (input/output/reasoning/cache_read/cache_write/total/cost_usd/model/cost_source).
- job_manager.complete()/fail(usage=): store normalized usage; API assignment complete/fail forward body.usage.
- scheduler backlog_status/epic_status: add usage rollup (sum tokens, sum cost).
- WorkerGrid: runtime wrapper workergrid/runtime/opencode_usage.py runs the runtime --format json, sums step usage,
  writes <worktree>/.wg/usage.json; Go agent forwards it as usage. PF stays framework-agnostic (no runtime names).

## Verify
- test_complete_records_usage_and_rollup; Go build/test; runtime JSON shape confirmed (step_finish.part.tokens+cost).
